name: deal-workbench
description: Use when analyzing M&A deals through a running deal workbench REST API. Triggers on any prompt mentioning a deal workbench at <TASK_ENV_BASE_URL>, deal IDs like PRJ_XXXXXX, seller or buyer APA/SPA review, committee escalation packages, transition reviews, deviation matrices, or workbench API routes like /api/deals, /api/playbooks, /api/policies, /api/query. Always use this skill when the task involves comparing draft deal terms against playbook or policy rules, producing structured JSON deal-analysis outputs, or gathering workbench data for M&A counsel deliverables.
